objective_contribution: Recover a repeated but fully accounted GLM length response with one additional bounded request so a 59,632-token trajectory can complete and the unchanged shared-prefix state hypothesis can receive evidence at 8K.

question_and_hypotheses.question: Does a second bounded fully accounted concise-action correction convert repeated GLM-5.3-flash length responses into completed 8K trajectories within the unchanged cumulative model-token cap?

measurement_mapping.native: Only native paired post-exposure scores estimate ContextBench evidence-selection usefulness; correction success alone establishes no semantic gain.
measurement_mapping.retention: Confirmed prior delivery, displacement, exact state presentation and independently scored later use remain required for a retention claim.
measurement_mapping.integrity: Verify each length receipt, durable acknowledgement, correction count, no uncertain replay, shared-prefix ancestry, exposure and terminal effects.
measurement_mapping.tokens: Count cumulative model input and output tokens for prefixes, failed length responses and every correction; keep the 96,000-token cap unchanged.
measurement_mapping.transfer: The bounded recovery mechanism is reusable, but this exposed GLM-5.3-flash 8K round cannot establish larger-window, model, domain, correctness or confirmation transfer.

acceptance_and_scope.window_order: Finish the GLM small-window chapter before larger windows, other models, or domains.
acceptance_and_scope.exposure: Same exposed eight-task cohort. Round 16 is historical and cannot resume. Reserved confirmation remains untouched.
acceptance_and_scope.stopping_rules: No within-round tuning, task replacement, source refresh, cap/threshold change or favorable rerun. Only the bounded incomplete-output loop and common maximum of two corrections may change.

retained_counterevidence: Round 16 completed only one of eight prefixes and three of 48 branches.
The one complete causal pair was descriptive and did not support H25: control span F1 exceeded state span F1 on that repetition.
A second state repetition completed with no paired control and cannot enter a causal estimate.
The failed control consumed 59,632 fully accounted model tokens before its second length response.
H26 instrument support does not establish useful state, correctness, completion advantage, transfer or ContextBench clearance.
Rounds 12 through 16 show heterogeneous semantic results and repeated instrument/runtime censoring.
successor_rule: First prove the bounded correction loop offline, then freeze and run each new cell once. Review H27 separately from H25. If repeated length still censors a branch, consider H28 without rerunning it. Every successor must pass policy v4 with exact canonical objectives and method.

criterion_verdicts.enduring_objective: The selected recovery seeks more completed reasoning outcomes per cumulative model input plus output tokens.
criterion_verdicts.initial_GLM_objective: The plan keeps GLM-5.3-flash at 8K and does not advance to larger windows.
criterion_verdicts.current_milestone: The fixed ContextBench contract remains unchanged and uncleared.
criterion_verdicts.method_and_predecessor: The exact method starts from reviewed Round 16 length receipts, compares H27, H28, H25 and H0, and selects the smallest directly evidenced mechanism.
criterion_verdicts.counterevidence: Incomplete coverage, the descriptive negative pair, unpaired state result, high failed-trajectory cost and claim limits are retained.
criterion_verdicts.measurement_and_token_cost: Instrument recovery, native quality, retention, integrity, transfer limits and every model input/output token remain separate.
criterion_verdicts.scope_and_acceptance: The same exposed cohort remains development evidence; reserved confirmation and other benchmarks remain outside the round.
criterion_verdicts.testability: A two-length-then-success oracle and a three-length stop oracle directly test the bounded mechanism before live spending.
